title: Cowboys & Aliens
description: First-person retro horde shooter on a frontier town. Hold the street against rounds of zombie-cowboys, screamer aliens, a six-shot sheriff boss every fifth round and aura-casting queens from round seven. Kills pay points that buy wall weapons, open the laundromat and bowling alley doors, and random drops can flip a round.
tagline: Hold the town. Six shots at a time.
controls: WASD to move, mouse to aim (click to lock), click to fire. Shift sprints, R reloads, F melee, E buys wall weapons and opens doors, 1-5 switches weapons. On touch: left thumb moves, drag to aim, tap to fire, walk onto drops to take them.
